issue.title: Make hosting choices explicit and manage self-hosted administrators

repository.name: calibrate-health
repository.description: calibrate is a responsive calorie tracker (desktop + mobile web) for people who want to lose (or maintain) weight by logging food and weight.

issue.body:
## Summary

Calibrate users need a clear service choice, and self-hosted operators need account administration without maintaining raw administrator IDs in deployment settings. This adds a managed-first native chooser, separate Service & hosting settings, and an administrator directory with confirmed role changes.

New self-hosted databases grant exactly one first-account owner. Existing installations import valid legacy IDs once. Fresh authorization checks, last-admin protection and verified-account recovery preserve access; directory reads no longer block ownership changes. Account/server changes retain master's offline and session-revocation protections.

Closes #438. Successor to #402, based directly on master. Related auth integration: #431/#437. [Original history/evidence retention](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/6b265afbb92951ba55e1c22212374225049c580e/pr402-recovery/retention-manifest.json).

## Test plan and behavior evidence

| Scenario | Expected and observed |
| --- | --- |
| Concurrent registrations, demotions/deletion, and directory scans | Eight real PostgreSQL scenarios passed: one first owner, no managed-host bootstrap, a verified admin survives competing removals, directory reads proceed during the ownership lock, and mid-scan revocation rejects results. Failed-delivery recovery and populated legacy import also passed. [CI log](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/actions/runs/37569261100/job/112623996176). |
| Admin/member access, promotion cancel/confirm, feature toggle and service navigation | Four desktop Chrome scenarios passed with synthetic data. Members cannot use admin controls; cancel sends no update; confirmation changes the displayed role. |
| Native server choice, cancellation, offline changes and late session responses | Component/session regressions passed, including credential clearing only after confirmation and late-token revocation. Native-device checks remain unexecuted and are deferred for review readiness, as detailed below. |

### Before / After

Actual master baseline: 4cbcbc74. Captured final/head: ce854348. Both use identical synthetic accounts, origin, clock, theme and scale; unrelated transient PWA notices are suppressed identically. Originals are unedited. [Exact source/build/fixture/harness identities and image hashes](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/8457ed1a3bbb0f0381b48e22a40aac52b223ae6c/pr439-evidence/provenance.json).

Settings now identifies the active service and gives hosting and administration clear navigation entries (matched 1280×1500 browser viewport).

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/8457ed1a3bbb0f0381b48e22a40aac52b223ae6c/pr439-evidence/before-settings.png) | ![After: settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/8457ed1a3bbb0f0381b48e22a40aac52b223ae6c/pr439-evidence/after-settings.png) |

Administration grows from a feature switch to server details and a bounded directory with verified status and role actions (matched 1280×2500 viewport, chosen to show all controls).

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: administration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/8457ed1a3bbb0f0381b48e22a40aac52b223ae6c/pr439-evidence/before-administration.png) | ![After: administration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/8457ed1a3bbb0f0381b48e22a40aac52b223ae6c/pr439-evidence/after-administration.png) |

## Supporting checks and limitations

CI passed: 786 backend tests (zero skipped), 1,319 mobile tests, 75 API-client tests, type checks, web/native bundles, critical web smoke, fresh/populated migrations and encrypted rollback. Local browser scenarios and source-bound export checks passed. [Complete published scope](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/8457ed1a3bbb0f0381b48e22a40aac52b223ae6c/pr439-evidence/published-scope.json): one focused commit, 63 files; no capture archive or temporary capture machinery in product history.

Current-head [Codex review](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/439#issuecomment-6031728424) reported no major issues. [Independent assessment at the same revision](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/bf82d9f38c8a488720ee0e97b1b2f59c97d464a6/pr439-qa/issue-rebind-20261007/verdict.json) found no new blocking source defect and verified the browser pairs.

**Deferred native-device checks (unexecuted):** managed/self-hosted selection; cancellation or failure retaining the current destination; confirmed service changes clearing credentials and consent; and preventing switches while offline changes are unresolved or unknown. No attached device or local emulator was available. The [human instruction](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/issues/405#issuecomment-6041659686) defers these checks for review readiness. Browser captures, component tests and native bundle checks do not establish device execution.

GitHub PR-page image rendering was not checked under the [general human waiver](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/issues/405#issuecomment-6022754087).

<details>
<summary>Exact previous issue438 description</summary>

<!-- issue438-original-body-begin -->
## Problem

Native users need a deliberate service choice that keeps credentials and recovery on the intended server. Self-hosted operators currently rely on environment-based administrator grants and need durable user-role management, safe first-owner setup and recovery. PR402 contains unmerged improvements, including a directory scan that holds the ownership lock and can block other account operations.

## Requirements and acceptance

- Preserve managed hosting as the default. Make native self-hosted selection explicit, tested and cancelable; failed/canceled selection preserves the current destination. Confirming a different service clears entered credentials and consent. Browser authentication and recovery remain on the serving origin.
- Separate Service & hosting from app diagnostics. Explain account/service boundaries and prevent switching while offline changes are unresolved or their state is unknown.
- Provide a bounded administrator directory containing only account ID, email, role, creation time and verification status. Require explicit role-change confirmation, fresh verified-admin authorization and last-verified-admin protection for demotion and deletion. Directory reads must not hold the exclusive ownership lock.
- Atomically grant exactly one first-account owner only on a genuinely new self-hosted database; never on managed hosting or a populated upgrade. Import valid existing legacy administrator IDs once, preserve an unverified owner's account after email-delivery failure, and recover only an existing verified account. Never reserve grants for future users.
- Preserve immediate authorization and account/server isolation across logout, refresh, cancellation and late responses, including master's offline workspace and revocation behavior. Keep issue421's credential-verification and atomic native-login contracts intact.
- Validate the database invariants with real cross-connection PostgreSQL cases, fresh/populated upgrade and rollback checks, and maintained client/API regressions. Demonstrate representative actual-base-to-final behavior with matched synthetic captures, including the native chooser. Historical After-only web images are not baseline evidence.

No provider activation, production account/access changes, credential changes, deployment or release is included. This scope follows the trusted human authorization for PR402 recovery and active backlog progression; related closed issues290/298 are context, while421/422 remain separate outcomes.

## Implementation plan

Follow the [retained recovery plan](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/6b265afbb92951ba55e1c22212374225049c580e/pr402-recovery/recovery-plan.md) for a focused successor from reverified master: preserve original evidence, selectively port useful product/tests/contracts/documentation, fix directory locking, and resolve the seven identified auth/API-client/rollback conflicts. Coordinate shared imports and test loaders with the existing421 owner; do not import or rewrite PR431/437. Keep capture archives and one-off capture machinery outside the successor's published product history. The authorized continuation is implemented in draft PR439. CI and matched browser evidence are complete. Actual native chooser evidence remains blocked by unavailable device/emulator access; independent engineering review/QA is pending.

## Implementing Codex task

Implementing owner: verified native task ID `01a1145f-aae2-70e0-af56-3952f0eab012` (shareable URL unavailable). This follows the original cloud owner `/root/improve_self_hosting_experience` and its [explicit idle handoff](https://github.com/MChartier/agentic-development-workflow/blob/e7c61c50d8be01437c15e0c3cfcd3fa683e81571/runtime-next-scope/pr402-owner-handoff.json).

## Implementing PR

Active implementing PR: [PR439](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/439) (draft). Historical original: [PR402](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/402), retained open until the coordinator verifies replacement, evidence and dependencies.
<!-- issue438-original-body-end -->

</details>

Metadata-only continuation under the human's native-device review-readiness deferral: https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/issues/405#issuecomment-6041659686 . Existing owner task01a1145f-aae2-70e0-af56-3952f0eab012 will retain original descriptions and reconcile PR439/issue438 wording with the explicit unperformed limitations. Headce854348 and master4cbcbc74 were reverified; no source change. Same independent QA follows the final body handoff. No readiness, draft, merge, release or Project transition is included.

issue.body:
## Summary
- Make managed Calibrate hosting the default end-user path, with an explicit, tested, cancelable self-hosted chooser
- Move account/service identity into Service & hosting, separate from app diagnostics and updates
- Add a server administration overview, capabilities, searchable/paginated user directory, and confirmed admin/member changes
- Persist server roles with atomic first-account ownership for new self-hosted databases; managed hosting never grants the first public registrant administrator access
- Import existing valid ADMIN_USER_IDS once, protect the last verified administrator, and provide an explicit recovery command for an existing verified account
- Isolate credentials, password recovery, in-flight refreshes, and admin mutations across account/server changes

## Verification
- Final head a341dcf2e736c8207c7e9296c1c7a8f67cf012f5 passed all six PR workflows: [Builds and browser smoke](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/actions/runs/36914903424), [Tests](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/actions/runs/36914903373), [Lint](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/actions/runs/36914903442), [Database upgrade/rollback](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/actions/runs/36914903405), [Dependency audit](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/actions/runs/36914903488), and [Production container scan](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/actions/runs/36914903426)
- 1,083 mobile tests passed (214 suites)
- 717 backend tests passed with test-concurrency=2; an initial unconstrained run had one governance-file failure that passed in isolation and in the complete rerun
- 73 API-client tests passed
- Full lint/typechecks, backend production build, and Expo web production build passed
- Web-release checks, release configuration checks, rollback ledger checks (14), and populated-upgrade unit checks (3) passed
- OpenAPI regeneration is byte-identical to the committed generated client
- Independent security review and re-review found no remaining blocking issue

## Rollout notes
- Migration 0042 stores admin/member roles and one-time bootstrap/import state
- CALIBRATE_HOSTED_SERVICE=true disables first-user ownership regardless of NODE_ENV
- Existing populated installations do not promote a new registrant automatically
- Existing zero-admin installations use the documented operator recovery command against an existing verified account
- No production access changes, merge, or deployment have been performed

## Screenshot evidence
[Full paired gallery: all 14 unedited PNGs](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/a341dcf2e736c8207c7e9296c1c7a8f67cf012f5/docs/pr-screenshots/self-hosting/README.md) · [Provenance and image hashes](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/a341dcf2e736c8207c7e9296c1c7a8f67cf012f5/docs/pr-screenshots/self-hosting/manifest.json) · [Original CI artifact](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/actions/runs/36913482326/artifacts/11188925700)

Captured from code commit df7e610812408e59a1e340dd8f32ab94fe4b4289. Real Chromium, synthetic intercepted API fixtures, no customer data or live role changes. The browser job passed 24 tests with no retries; every capture was visually inspected. These are web viewport screenshots, not native-device evidence. The subsequent gallery commit changes only documentation/images.

| Phone web, 390 × 844 | Desktop web, 1440 × 1000 |
| --- | --- |
| [![Service & hosting, phone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/a341dcf2e736c8207c7e9296c1c7a8f67cf012f5/docs/pr-screenshots/self-hosting/android-phone-chrome-service-hosting.png)](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/a341dcf2e736c8207c7e9296c1c7a8f67cf012f5/docs/pr-screenshots/self-hosting/android-phone-chrome-service-hosting.png) | [![Service & hosting, desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/a341dcf2e736c8207c7e9296c1c7a8f67cf012f5/docs/pr-screenshots/self-hosting/desktop-chrome-service-hosting.png)](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/a341dcf2e736c8207c7e9296c1c7a8f67cf012f5/docs/pr-screenshots/self-hosting/desktop-chrome-service-hosting.png) |

timeline.body:
Managed-first planning is complete; no product changes or tests were run. Recommendation: a focused successor from actual master. PR439 publishes one commit across 63 files (+3,360/-729), including backend roles, migration and administration. An in-place reversal would retain superseded chooser work and broaden the published review range. Preserve that branch, backend work, tests and evidence; this proposal does not authorize closure or history rewriting.

| Source/path inventory | Proposed treatment |
| --- | --- |
| `mobile/app/(auth)/login.tsx`, `register.tsx`; `mobile/src/components/ServerUrlControl.tsx`; `auth/authServerDraft.ts` | Remove chooser, candidate state and backend URL route inputs. Keep credential validation, consent and submit guards. |
| `mobile/app/forgot-password.tsx`, `reset-password.tsx`, `verify-email.tsx` | Bind recovery to the configured native/serving browser origin; incoming route parameters must not select an endpoint. |
| `mobile/app/(tabs)/(settings)/advanced.tsx`, `settings.tsx`; `settings/SettingsHome.tsx`, `navigation/routeRegistry.ts` | Remove runtime connection setup and hosting promotion; retain diagnostics, software updates and authorized admin access. Do not port PR439's `service.tsx` route or hosting overview/promotion. |
| `README.md`, `mobile/README.md`, `mobile/app.json`, `legal/publicLegalContent.ts` | Remove promotional onboarding and OS-permission wording; use accurate development/internal-purpose wording where needed. Keep factual independent-operator privacy/deletion boundaries and internal deployment instructions. Actual `mobile/app/index.web.tsx` already has no self-hosting promotion. |
| `mobile/src/config/server.ts`, `auth/storage.ts`, both `AuthContext` files, `offline/{database,provider,queuedMutation}` | Make the build target authoritative; add origin-bound startup migration before credentials/replay. Retain PR439's session-generation isolation fixes selectively. |
| `auth/offlineWorkspace.ts`, `auth/logoutIntent*`, `onboarding/draftStorage.ts`, `healthConnect/storageScope.ts`, `wear/*` | Preserve origin/account namespaces, pending revocation and retained health data. Verify consumers never inherit a new target's credentials. |

Migration contract: equal known legacy/configured origins retain their session. A different known target requires fresh authentication and cleared active credential/consent state; never relabel old tokens or data. Unknown/malformed legacy identity, unreadable storage or any pending/failed/replaying changes holds startup before authenticated network/replay and preserves the originals. Provide retry and matching-build recovery guidance, without a runtime selector or automatic discard. Make migration restart-safe and inspect all relevant old namespaces, not only the currently visible account. With a proven empty outbox, preserve old local records while starting a separate target session.

Reusable release-owner facts:

- `EXPO_PUBLIC_CALIBRATE_SERVER_URL` is read directly by `config/server.ts`. Native defaults are configured URL, otherwise existing hosted production or simulator loopback in development. Today a persisted native choice overrides release defaults; development configuration overrides the saved choice. Tokens are currently global SecureStore keys. Browser production ignores native saved/configured choices and uses its serving origin.
- `mobile/eas.json`: internal channel uses preview environment; production uses production; iOS simulator extends internal. `app.config.js` independently reads `EXPO_UPDATES_CHANNEL` (default internal) and `EXPO_PUBLIC_EAS_PROJECT_ID`, uses appVersion runtime policy, and sets update request headers. Channel is update routing, not the backend URL. EAS profile channel and the custom header input must agree.
- `scripts/expo-native-dev.mjs` already supplies the explicit URL from process/repository build environment or allocated simulator port. `native-release-build.mjs` validates a credential-free HTTPS origin and supplies it to phone and Wear. `native-internal-release.mjs` currently overwrites URL/project/channel with fixed instance constants; generalizing that release helper belongs to the release owner, without new hardcoded private values.

repository.name: calibrate-health
repository.description: calibrate is a responsive calorie tracker (desktop + mobile web) for people who want to lose (or maintain) weight by logging food and weight.

issue.body:
## Problem

Releasing Calibrate currently requires separate server, native and OTA decisions and commands. The user wants one manually invoked GitHub Action to manage versions, determine which artifacts changed, and prepare Android and iOS/TestFlight delivery before production. Published Little Say PR37 is a reference, not permission to execute its release operations.

## Requirements and acceptance

- Provide one manual release entrypoint that plans server image, Android/iOS native build and compatible OTA work from an exact protected source revision. Automatic change detection compares each artifact/profile/platform with its last successful compatible result, not merely the last release tag.
- Manage versions and platform build numbers consistently. Preserve candidate CI/review gates and exact-source verification; no publishing from ordinary merges. Explicit plans, no-change results and validation failures must be readable.
- Preserve successful artifact identities across partial failures and retries; reconcile uncertain provider responses, reject conflicting receipts and avoid duplicate version allocation, builds, images or submissions. Test recovery and idempotency using fixtures/mocks.
- Prepare iOS/TestFlight and Android distribution code/configuration alongside native/OTA compatibility and runtime fingerprints. Publication, store rollout, server deployment and device uptake remain distinct.
- Keep personal/account/Expo-project/signing configuration out of the public repository, logs and artifacts. Use documented secret/environment inputs and redaction where appropriate; client backend configuration necessarily shipped in a bundle is observable and must not be described as secret.
- Honor managed-first build-time backend targeting from [the product amendment](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/issues/405#issuecomment-6049386828). An Expo channel alone must not be assumed to set a backend URL.
- This task authorizes source/configuration/docs/tests and a draft PR with independent QA only. No actual release, image/OTA publication, cloud build spend, Apple/Play upload or submission, signing/credential setup, merge or deployment.

## Implementation plan

Reconcile current master, the existing release-entrypoint PR441 and merged Little Say PR37. Prefer a distinct dependent PR pinned to PR441 only if its changes are needed; otherwise use reverified master. Preserve PR441 and coordinate ownership before overlapping edits.

Build an immutable selective-artifact plan using each platform/profile’s last verified successful receipt. Reuse Calibrate’s existing publication workers, exact-source CI and image/signing trust verification. Bind endpoint, EAS project, environment, channel, runtime/native fingerprint and source in build/export/OTA receipts. Current EAS profiles select preview/production separately from the update header; validate agreement rather than assume channel names choose endpoints.

Generalize native-internal-release.mjs instance constants through validated external configuration, coordinating that helper and release docs with #438. Extend iOS version/store build and submission preparation without disrupting Android phone/Wear allocation. Existing iOS bundle/simulator configuration is not TestFlight readiness. Verify current primary Expo/Apple requirements; keep account/signing inputs external and exact-build selection explicit.

Incorporate Little Say issue41’s verified retirement/tombstone and interrupted-run reconciliation design once available; do not copy its pre-fix cleanup behavior. Test no-change, individual/combined artifacts, incompatible OTA, stale candidates, missing CI, partial success, lost responses and retries using fixtures. Preparation needs no live credentials; provider operations remain unperformed.

[Original issue requirements and plan](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/issues/447#issuecomment-6065173979) remain preserved.

## Implementing Codex task

Existing verified release owner: task ID `01a114af-c6d1-705c-ade9-39553731d038`. Current new-outcome planning admission is pending; a verified task ID is used because a shareable link is unavailable.

## Implementing PR

Not created for this new outcome. PR441 remains the earlier bounded release-entrypoint checkpoint; no supersession or merge is implied.

issue.title: Make Calibrate backend targeting build-time only

repository.name: calibrate-health
repository.description: calibrate is a responsive calorie tracker (desktop + mobile web) for people who want to lose (or maintain) weight by logging food and weight.

issue.body:
## Summary

Calibrate currently exposes native backend selection and promotes self-hosting in Advanced settings. A build configured for a different backend could also inherit globally stored credentials unless startup first establishes their origin.

This change removes runtime backend controls and URL route inputs. Native/internal builds use `EXPO_PUBLIC_CALIBRATE_SERVER_URL`; production browsers use their serving origin. Native startup retains a session only for a known matching origin. A changed target requires fresh sign-in, while pending or unreadable local state blocks the transition and preserves the original data with recovery guidance.

Closes #438. This is the focused client successor to #439; its deferred administrator/bootstrap work and original evidence remain preserved. No parent PR, backend/auth-stack changes or release-helper changes are included.

## Test plan and behavior evidence

| Scenario | Expected and observed |
| --- | --- |
| Open Advanced settings | Hosting promotion and switching controls are absent; diagnostics and software updates remain. Matched browser captures below and maintained native component tests passed. |
| Start with matching, changed or unknown legacy origins | Matching sessions retain credentials. Safe changed targets start signed out; queued changes, unknown identity, unreadable storage and interrupted writes preserve originals and block unsafe authentication/replay. Maintained migration, storage and startup-gate regressions passed. |
| Complete old requests after logout/account replacement | Old callbacks cannot obtain replacement credentials or clear the replacement session; late native tokens are queued for revocation. Maintained session-race tests passed. |
| Request password reset with a legacy backend URL parameter | The request remains on the serving origin. A synthetic 503 displays retry guidance without changing destinations; both independent browser captures and recorded request URLs confirm this. |

### Before / After

**Advanced settings:** removes self-hosting promotion while preserving support diagnostics and update controls.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: Advanced settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/a7d2ad1648d2b743cdfda5ef66950f6feee741ad/managed-438/before-advanced.png) | ![After: Advanced settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/a7d2ad1648d2b743cdfda5ef66950f6feee741ad/managed-438/after-advanced.png) |

**Password-reset failure:** recovery remains available on the serving origin. These are independent captures of intentionally unchanged UI.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: reset failure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/a7d2ad1648d2b743cdfda5ef66950f6feee741ad/managed-438/before-recovery-failure.png) | ![After: reset failure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/a7d2ad1648d2b743cdfda5ef66950f6feee741ad/managed-438/after-recovery-failure.png) |

Before is actual master `4cbcbc740fbe5fa5646b4de31951c79a653176d5`; After is `8a6d1af405a8fbabfc9fdd9d2120eef510f5bd36`. Separate builds used the same synthetic fixtures, 1280×1100 light browser viewport and frozen inputs. The shared harness hides unrelated transient PWA notices; compared UI pixels are unaltered. [Exact provenance](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/a7d2ad1648d2b743cdfda5ef66950f6feee741ad/managed-438/provenance.json), [fixture/hash clarification](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/a7d2ad1648d2b743cdfda5ef66950f6feee741ad/managed-438/provenance-notes.json), [artifact digests](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/a7d2ad1648d2b743cdfda5ef66950f6feee741ad/managed-438/artifact-digests.json) and [complete scope](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/a7d2ad1648d2b743cdfda5ef66950f6feee741ad/managed-438/scope.json) are retained outside product history.

## Supporting checks and limitations

Passed: mobile typecheck; 235 mobile suites/1,320 tests; 69 API-client tests; four maintained desktop/compact PWA checks; independent Before/After web builds and four capture pairs; Android JavaScript export.

Native-device/emulator checks are deferred and unexecuted; component tests and bundling are not device execution. Independent review/QA and current CI reconciliation remain pending. Actual GitHub page-rendering inspection is waived under the recorded human amendment; genuine captures and independent pixel inspection remain required.
